text: DSH Skills & MCPs Group Manager 是面向 Web 客户端的技能与 MCP 管理插件。它在 DSH 左侧面板提供分组管理界面，并通过共享工具和浏览器 RPC 操作状态。用户可以创建、重命名、启用或删除技能组，将技能加入组以筛选注入目录，也能查看、添加、启用、停用和移除 MCP 服务器。分组与服务器配置保存在本机状态文件中，适合需要整理技能目录或管理 MCP 连接的 DSH 用户；添加 stdio 服务器可填写命令和参数，HTTP 服务器可填写 URL。

DSH Skills & MCPs Group Manager is a web plugin for organizing skill groups and managing MCP servers. Its panel lets users filter skill injection by enabled groups and list, add, toggle, or remove servers. Settings are local; stdio servers use a command and streamable HTTP servers use a URL.

DSH Skills & MCPs Group Manager 的功能「技能组管理」：创建、重命名、启用或删除技能组，并将技能加入或移出分组。通过面板或 manager_groups_* 工具操作，变更保存到状态文件并刷新技能目录。
DSH Skills & MCPs Group Manager 的功能「按组筛选技能」：启用组中技能名称的并集构成允许目录；其他技能在影子 provider 返回时被标记为不可调用。分组变更会使技能目录失效并刷新。
DSH Skills & MCPs Group Manager 的功能「MCP 服务器管理」：列出 profile 和用户添加的 MCP 服务器，并独立启停；用户添加的服务器支持 stdio 或 streamable-http 连接类型。
DSH Skills & MCPs Group Manager 的功能「浏览器管理面板」：在对话界面提供 Skills 与 MCP 管理面板，通过 POST RPC 与宿主共享状态操作交互。面板含分组、技能选择和 MCP 管理视图。
分组和 MCP 条目保存在 DSH_HOME/mcp-skill-manager/state.json；未指定 DSH_HOME 时状态目录位于用户主目录下的 .dsh。卸载清理脚本会删除该插件状态目录。

dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager README · ✨ 功能特性 / Features：- **🎯 Skill Groups** — create / rename / delete groups, groups are collapsible; both the member and picker views are list + multi-select, supporting select-all / deselect-all after search filtering and batch add / remove.
- **🧠 Injection Filtering** — the context injects only the Skills that appear in enabled groups (union, deduplicated, one at a time); ungrouped Skills are not injected by default; switching groups refreshes the catalog live.
- **🔌 MCP Management** — enumerate all MCP servers (profile config + user-added) and toggle them independently; user-added MCPs are mounted dynamically and persisted, restored automatically on restart.
- **💾 Persistence** — `~/.dsh/mcp-skill-manager/state.json` (atomic write); the next session reuses the previous group settings by default.
- **🖥️ UI** — a group-management panel on the left of the dialog (`shell.overlay`) + a session-header toggle (`conversation.session.header.actions`, with a "Skills&MCPs" label). A pure floating panel; it does not modify the product layout, and follows the DSH design language with loading / error / empty states and keyboard focus feedback.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager
```

On uninstall pnpm runs the package's `postuninstall` script (`scripts/cleanup.mjs`), which deletes the entire state directory `~/.dsh/mcp-skill-manager/` (including `state.json`), so groups and MCP configuration are removed together with the plugin. Manual removal also works: `rm -rf ~/.dsh/mcp-skill-manager`.
